newsitem.title: USA: Wired Ventures said to cut IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Wired Ventures said to cut IPO price range.

text.p: Wired Ventures Inc has cut the estimated pricing range of its initial public offering to $8 to $10 a share from its prior estimate of $12 to $14, according to a source close to one of the underwriters.
The deal is in hot water and could possibly be pulled, according to sources in the equity investment community.
Many of the equity investment officials were wary of the deal even after it was re-priced, with talk that the New York publishing community had been shocked at the high valuations.
